import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert categorical columns to categorical
data['sex'] = data['sex'].astype('category')
data['class'] = data['class'].astype('category')
data['embarked'] = data['embarked'].astype('category')
data['deck'] = data['deck'].astype('category')
data['alive'] = data['alive'].astype('category')

# Create a bar chart of survival rate by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=data)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of survival rate by class
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='class', hue='survived', data=data)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Class')

plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(data['age'], binrange=(0, 80), kde=True)
plt.title('Age Distribution')
